speaker: Sam
text: Thanks for making time, Dana. Last quarter you were piloting with the ops team, how did that go?

speaker: Dana
text: Pretty well overall. The team likes the dashboards and the weekly summaries land on time.

speaker: Sam
text: Great to hear. Anything blocking a wider rollout?

speaker: Dana
text: A few things. First, our finance group lives in spreadsheets, so we really need to be able to export the weekly reports to CSV. Right now they copy and paste.

speaker: Sam
text: Understood, a CSV export of the reports. Noted.

speaker: Dana
text: Second, honestly it would be great if everything were just a bit faster, but that's not a deal breaker.

speaker: Sam
text: Fair. We're working on performance generally.

speaker: Dana
text: The onboarding last time was a little confusing too, but your team walked us through it.

speaker: Sam
text: Thanks for the candor, we've reworked the onboarding since then.

speaker: Dana
text: Do you already support Slack notifications for new alerts?

speaker: Sam
text: Yes, Slack notifications are built in, you can turn them on under Settings.

speaker: Dana
text: Perfect, we'll use that. Now the big one: our CRM is Salesforce, and we'd need a Salesforce integration so deals sync automatically before we can roll this out to sales.

speaker: Sam
text: A Salesforce integration, got it. That's not available today.

speaker: Dana
text: Right, so that's a requirement for us, not a nice to have.

speaker: Priya
text: Hi, I'm Priya, I run security for Acme. Can I jump in on one thing?

speaker: Sam
text: Of course, welcome Priya.

speaker: Priya
text: We require single sign-on through Okta for every tool we adopt. Without SSO we can't approve it.

speaker: Sam
text: Okta single sign-on, understood. I'll take that back to the product team.

speaker: Dana
text: Pricing wise, we were quoted for two hundred and fifty seats last time, is that still right?

speaker: Sam
text: That's right, I'll send an updated quote by Friday.

speaker: Dana
text: Great. And Priya will own the contract review on our side.

speaker: Priya
text: Yes, send me the security questionnaire when you have it.

speaker: Sam
text: Will do. Let's schedule a follow up for next Thursday.

speaker: Dana
text: Thursday works. Thanks everyone.
